description: Declaration of the AdbWinUsbInterfaceObject class, which encapsulates a USB interface accessible via WinUsb API, including methods for handle management, endpoint information, and serial number retrieval.

classes.name: AdbWinUsbInterfaceObject
classes.description: A class that manages a USB interface on a device accessible via WinUsb API, handling handles, endpoints, and serial number retrieval.

methods.name: AdbWinUsbInterfaceObject
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with the interface name.

methods.name: ~AdbWinUsbInterfaceObject
methods.description: Destructor, hidden to prevent stack allocation.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Overrides to manage object lifetime and ensure deletion in the correct module context.

methods.name: CreateHandle
methods.description: Creates a handle for the interface, initializing WinUsb API.

methods.name: CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes the handle and removes the object from handle map.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of the interface's device.

methods.name: GetEndpointInformation
methods.description: Gets information about a specific endpoint.

methods.name: OpenEndpoint
methods.description: Opens an endpoint on the interface.
